# FSM source translations
# Format:
# ObjectPath|FsmName|StateName|ActionIndex|Original text fragment = Translated text fragment
#
# Empty FsmName is allowed, but "Data" is accepted as the default FSM name for
# paths where the hook finds the FSM by state.
